dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: I still come here often, waiting for Godwin to come back... I pray he steers clear of those rotten hilichurls and the Abyss Order on the way... so he can come back to me soon.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Ah, I'm rambling again... Sorry, it's just so nice having someone to talk to.

response.speaker: Glory
response.text: Grand Master Varka told me that Godwin's expedition isn't over yet. He'll be continuing his fight in Nod-Krai...

response.speaker: Glory
response.text: I've received many letters from him recently. They're always so long... as if there's something he wants to say, but can't quite bring himself to put into words, so he keeps circling around it instead.

response.speaker: Glory
response.text: ...He doesn't need to say that much. I already understand what he's trying to tell me. I suppose you know that feeling too, right?

response.speaker: Glory
response.text: That's why I want to believe... this time, he'll keep his promise.

choices.text: Tell me more about the hilichurls and the Abyss Order.

response.speaker: Glory
response.text: You must find them a nuisance too? All they do is go round causing mischief.

response.speaker: Glory
response.text: I heard that most of the hilichurls suddenly appeared in Teyvat out of nowhere several hundred years ago... And the same for the Abyss Order, actually.

response.speaker: Glory
response.text: Some said they were borne of some great catastrophe that descended on Teyvat... But I think they probably came from outer space!

response.speaker: Glory
response.text: ...Sorry, because I can't see, my imagination sometimes runs a bit wild. Just ignore it.
